description: Remove a memory from the focus buffer
embedding_description: WRITE/REMOVE: unpin one memory from the actr_memory focus buffer by memory_id so it stops being injected into every prompt. Returns memory_id + confirmation message. Use to free a focus slot when working-memory content is no longer load-bearing for the current task. EDGE verb. Sibling to focus (write/add) and get_focused_action (read enumeration).
